cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Help Me Keep This Quiet
cards.instruction: Get someone to help contain a secret without first revealing its full risk or purpose.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Hide this envelope under the picnic hamper before Mum comes in. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She asked me to unpack the hamper.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Then keep the envelope in your pocket while you unpack.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll end up taking it home.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Perfect. I'll explain when she stops asking where it is.

mechanism: A directs concealment of an envelope and adapts the hiding place around B tasks and departure, keeping B responsible without explaining the secret.
confusable: Unlike fully informed cooperation, B is recruited before learning purpose or risk; authority changes the method so B can still comply with Mum.
comparison: A family picnic task and taking an object away differ from temporary key custody under a flatmate deadline.
seedUse: D121-a envelope, hamper and pocket; S02-a adapts a directive when B has conflicting work.
